name: Notes help
description: Help mode entries for the Notes browser plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Notes
entries.text: Every note saved for Brett in one place: the AmberX app's notes or the hub's shared Claude files. Classic shows the notes on the left and the open note on the right; Grid shows them as rows you can sort and tap open. Long notes fold into sections.

entries.title: New note
entries.text: Makes a new note in the folder you pick and opens it for editing.

entries.title: New folder
entries.text: Adds a folder to the notes. Notes can be moved into it afterwards.

entries.title: Reload
entries.text: Reads the notes again from the hub, to pick up notes another session just saved.

entries.title: Search notes
entries.text: Shows only the notes whose title or text contains every word you type.

entries.title: Sort notes
entries.text: Newest puts the most recently changed notes first; Name sorts them by title.

entries.title: Edit
entries.text: Turns the note into editable text. Save only goes through when nobody else changed the note since you opened it; otherwise reload it first.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves your changes to the hub. The old text is kept in the hub's history.

entries.title: Rename
entries.text: Gives the note a new name (and folder, if you pick one). Its history stays on the hub.

entries.title: Move to
entries.text: Moves the note to another folder.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Asks first, then takes the note out of the notes. The hub keeps its last text in its history.

entries.title: Newest
entries.text: Sorts the notes so the most recently changed come first.

entries.title: Name
entries.text: Sorts the notes by title, A to Z.

entries.title: Note text (Markdown)
entries.text: The note's text while Edit is on. Markdown: # for headings, - for lists, backticks for code.

entries.title: Note title
entries.text: The new note's title; it also becomes its file name.

entries.title: Folder
entries.text: The folder the note goes in.

entries.title: Notes settings
entries.text: Where the notes are kept, and the plugin's install and uninstall panel.

entries.title: Reload the notes
entries.text: Someone else changed this note while you were editing it. Reload to get their version, then make your change again.

entries.title: ALL-CAPS lines are section headers
entries.text: When on, a line written in capitals that starts a paragraph, like “JUST MERGED (Nov 4)”, folds like a Markdown heading.

entries.title: Start with sections collapsed
entries.text: Notes open with every section folded. A section you opened or closed yourself stays that way on this device.

entries.title: Classic view
entries.text: The notes on the left, the open note on the right, with its sections folding.

entries.title: Grid view
entries.text: The notes as rows you can sort, filter and tap open to read the whole note.

entries.title: AmberX notes
entries.text: Shows the notes from the AmberX app, the same ones on every device.

entries.title: Claude files
entries.text: Shows the notes saved in the hub's shared Claude files: handoffs, plans, install notes and saved commands.

entries.title: Open in Classic
entries.text: Switches to the Classic view with this note open.

entries.title: Close all rows
entries.text: Folds every open row of the grid back up.

entries.title: Priority
entries.text: The note's priority from AmberX (blank when it has none). Tap the header to sort by it.

entries.title: Due
entries.text: When the note is due, if it has a date. Tap the header to sort by it.

entries.title: Sections
entries.text: How many foldable sections the note has (headings and ALL-CAPS header lines).

entries.title: Length
entries.text: How long the note is, in characters.

entries.title: Pin
entries.text: Pins the note in AmberX (or unpins it), so it shows in AmberX's Pinned tab.

steps.say: Every note you asked Claude to save is here, sorted into folders on the left.
Search finds a note by any word in it. Tap one to read it; switch Edit on to change it.
